raw.summary: The Hazleton Farmer’s Night Market runs from July 31 through the end of October at Hazle Park on Washington Avenue in West Hazleton, Pennsylvania. The market is open on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 2 p.m. to 6 p.m., offering fresh local produce directly from farms.

This annual 24-day event features a wide array of entertainment, including new amusement rides, regional culinary offerings, and a specific focus on affordability through its "Every Day Values" program.

events.title: Arts Center East Holiday Artisan Craft Fair 2026

raw.name: Arts Center East Holiday Artisan Craft Fair 2026
raw.description: Arts Center East's Annual Holiday Artisan Craft Fair returns to 709 Hartford Turnpike in Vernon for its 12th year, showcasing work from over 60 local and regional artisans — soaps, lotions, candles, jewelry, stationery, ceramics, wood crafts, textiles, home decor and gift items. The fair is open two full Thursday-to-Sunday weekends in November: November 12–15 and November 19–22, closed the days in between. Hours are 1–5pm Thursday and Friday, 9am–4pm Saturday and 10am–2pm Sunday. Note for makers: this is a consignment fair rather than a booth show — Arts Center East handles all selling, restocking and sales tax and retains a 35% commission (25% for artist members), with artisans buying a half table at $40 or a full table at $80 rather than staffing a booth.

raw.description: Introduction The Identity & Access Management Summit 2026 is a premier event focused on the critical aspects of identity management and cybersecurity. Scheduled to take place in Las Vegas, this summit will bring together industry leaders and technology innovators to discuss and explore groundbreaking strategies in identity governance. Las Vegas, known for its vibrant atmosphere and cutting-edge technology scene, serves as the perfect backdrop for such an important conference. Attendees will have the opportunity to network, learn, and gain insights that can transform their approach to identity and access management. Event Overview Organized by Gartner, a global leader in research and advisory services, the summit draws professionals from diverse sectors including information technology, cybersecurity, and business management. Typically, attendees range from CIOs and IT security experts to compliance officers and system integrators. Local residents and visitors in Las Vegas should attend to stay ahead of the curve in identity management trends, gain insights from thought leaders, and discover best practices to enhance organizational security postures. Unique Features/Events The Identity & Access Management Summit 2026 will feature a lineup of distinguished speakers who are experts in the field. These keynotes will address pressing issues such as digital transformation in identity management, the role of artificial intelligence, and compliance challenges. In addition to keynote presentations, attendees can expect interactive sessions, panel discussions, and workshops that facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration. The event offers unique networking opportunities, allowing participants to connect with peers and reshape their understanding of identity management solutions. Call-to-Action Don’t miss your chance to be part of the Identity & Access Management Summit 2026 in Las Vegas. Gain valuable insights, network with industry leaders, and deepen your understanding of identity governance. Get your tickets now and join the conversation that will shape the future of identity management! For more information and ticket purchases, visit http://www.gartner.com/.

The 2027 Annual Medical Education Conference (AMEC) is set to take place in the vibrant city of Las Vegas, creating an ideal backdrop for the exchange of innovative ideas in medical education. This prestigious event, hosted by the Student National Medical Association (SNMA), gathers medical students, educators, and healthcare professionals from across the country to engage in thought-provoking discussions and workshops dedicated to advancing medical education. The AMEC is known for its commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the field of medicine. Participants will benefit from a rich agenda aimed at enhancing their understanding of various educational methodologies and best practices. Las Vegas locals or visitors seeking to expand their professional network and knowledge in medical education will find this conference particularly beneficial. With opportunities to connect with peers, mentors, and industry leaders, attendees can forge valuable relationships that may enhance their careers and contribute to their personal growth. The conference is typically attended by medical students from various institutions, faculty members, and healthcare professionals. This diverse mix fosters a collaborative environment where participants can share their experiences and insights into the challenges and triumphs of medical education. Furthermore, the conference offers numerous networking opportunities, making it an essential gathering for anyone involved in the medical field. Unique features of the AMEC include keynote speeches from renowned leaders in medical education and engaging workshops that delve into the latest trends and research. Participants can expect thought-provoking sessions that cover a wide range of topics relevant to the future of healthcare education. The event thrives on interactive discussions, allowing attendees to engage directly with experts and ask questions that concern their individual academic and professional journeys. Don’t miss out on this major event in the medical education calendar! Mark your calendars and get your tickets now to be a part of this transformative experience at the 2027 Annual Medical Education Conference in Las Vegas! Visit http://www.snma.org/ for more information and to secure your spot today.
